title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

Submit the online application on or before 29.08.2026 till 11:59 P.M.
No other mode of application shall be considered.

Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator Skill Certificate Holders [Code 111]

howToApply: Visit the IOCL official website www.iocl.com from 14-07-2026 till 12-08-2026.
Ensure you have a valid and active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number registered on NAPS/NATS portal.

STEP I: For Codes 101, 102, 108, 109, 110 & 111 – Register on NAPS portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ and apply for the relevant opportunity under IOCL Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex.
For Codes 104, 105, 106 & 107 – Register on NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and apply for the advertisement notified by IOCL Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex on your dashboard.
Use Establishment ID: NHRPPC000003 (for NATS) or E10150600035 (for NAPS) for Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex.
STEP II: After applying on NAPS/NATS portal, mandatorily submit additional details in Microsoft Forms by visiting the link at www.iocl.com.
Ensure all details in Microsoft Forms match those in the NAPS/NATS portal (Enrollment No./Student ID/Registration No., email ID, mobile number).
Both Step I and Step II must be completed for the application to be considered valid.
Candidates applying for Code 108 (Secretarial Assistant) must specify their preferred training location (Panipat or New Delhi) in Microsoft Forms.
